user.description:
To obtain the necessary credentials access https://app.trading212.com/ using a web browser. In the account settings, under API (Beta), generate a new API Key ID and Secret Key. When generating the API Key, select the following permissions:
* Account Data
* Metadata
* Orders - Read
* Pies - Read
* Portfolio

**DO NOT SELECT ANY OF THE _Write_ or _Execute_ PERMISSIONS! USE AT YOUR OWN RISK.**

**NOTE:** Trading 212 API has a low request rate limit, which means that the setup process will take some time. Be patient when moving between steps.
